verdict.rationale: The AMD Ryzen 9 9950X3D is a desktop CPU, a hardware component with no web service, so a downloadable OpenAPI-style spec is a category error for this product type. Nothing in the evidence shows the product itself exposes such an API. The mentions of Ryzen Master and Ryzen AI Software do not describe a machine-readable API spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
